question: What intense experience at the tip of nectar affects even the wise practitioner?
premises: The locus is the tip of nectar
inference: Even the wise one experiences burning at the tip of nectar by the essence.
uncertainties: The imagery of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa is obscure.
plain_english: Even the wise one burns at the tip of nectar with the essence of its juice.
